summary: Live operator site and booking engine are Cloudflare-walled (UNREAD); from the operator's own pages archived 2026-04-30 confirmed 229 sites, year-round, own reservation site with a 90-day window; stored 2026-08-05 rates left; pin ~290 m off the campers' centre.
flags: UNREAD: https://www.mountkiddrv.com/ and /rates-fees return a Cloudflare 'Performing security verification' page to both curl and the headless browser; reserve.mountkiddrv.com returns 403. Facts above come from Wayback captures of the operator's own pages (home 2026-04-30; seasonal schedule 2025-03-20). The stored fees (rates 'last verified 2026-08-05') were not re-read and are left as stored.

Website: there is no Alberta Parks camping page for Mount Kidd (Evan-Thomas PRA page lists none; guessed URLs 404). The operator's campsite page is https://www.mountkiddrv.com/sites (Sites Map; archived 2026-04-30, live blocked by Cloudflare) and its schedule page https://www.mountkiddrv.com/full-seasonal-schedule. Recommend https://www.mountkiddrv.com/sites as the camping page.
Booking platform: the operator's own reservation site (reserve.mountkiddrv.com) with a 'Sliding 90-day' window, written over the provincial:AB inherited platform/url.

Seasonal services (2025 schedule): full hookups only in summer (May 17 - Sept 15) on loops A, B and E 1-11; power only spring/autumn and on loop D year-round; loops B, C, E, F closed Oct 15 - Apr 30. Amperage not stated on any page read; electric left absent.
Phone +1 403-591-7700 confirmed (operator 'Front Desk', Google). Google 4.5 from 860 reviews.

PIN MOVE: stored 50.8878,-115.1450 is on the access road east of the loops, ~150 m from the nearest sites. Google's point 50.88968,-115.14793 is the campers' centre (tennis courts) in the middle of the park, ~290 m away. Recommend 50.8897,-115.1479.

Waterfront: not waterfront kept. The Kananaskis River runs ~80-140 m west of the westmost loop behind forest, and its gravel bed lies ~60-80 m north of the north loops behind trees; no site meets the ~50 m open-ground gate on imagery.
